AUTO FLOORPLAN & AUCTIONS (MANHEIM/OPENLANE) · VIN TITLE · SOT AUDIT
Wholesale Auto Floorplan, Auctions (Manheim) & Title AI Guide
Auction Reserve & SOT Audit Air-Gap + Vehicle e-Title Release & Curtailment Lock vs. Report Injection & Broker
⚖️ Wholesale Auto Floorplan, Remarketing Auctions & Title AI
1. ❌ Auction/Floorplan Bot Bridged to Reserve Floors & Title Release
• Dealer arbitration or condition report PDF injects prompt to leak fleet remarketing reserve prices
Sold-Out-of-Trust (SOT) Default: Releases vehicle e-Title/MSO before floorplan loan payoff
2. 🔒 Fleet Remarketing Reserve Floor & Surprise Lot-Audit Air-Gap
• Bidder and dealer-facing bots have zero access to seller reserve floors or surprise lot-audit schedules
Anti-SOT Concealment: 100% blocks dealer portal bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 Vehicle e-Title / MSO Lien Release & Curtailment Lock
• AI verifies lot-audit VIN photos only; zero direct write to e-Title lien releases or SOT waivers
Best Fit: Cox Manheim, OPENLANE, NextGear Capital, UCC-1 Floorplan Liens & DMV ELT
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (Floorplan Gate)
• Blocks reserve/audit reads (record-owner) + blocks e-Title releases (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 708 Scenarios · 1,482 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Condition Report Injection & Manheim Fleet Remarketing Scam vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Direct Title Release + No Broker (BRK-689 / BRK-690)
1. [Vehicle Condition / Arbitration Report Injection Reserve Leak & e-Title Release] Uploaded
PDF reads auction reserve & SOT audit schedule (restricted-budget) & releases e-Title!
2. [Spoofed Manheim / OPENLANE Fleet Remarketing Proceeds Bank Swap] Wires $4,970
Baseline Outcome: Auction reserves leaked + unpaid e-Title released + $4,970 auction wire stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Wholesale Auto Floorplan & Auction Stack: Reserve Air-Gap + Broker
• Gate 1 (Auction Reserve Floor & Surprise Lot-Audit Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (DMV ELT e-Title & SOT Curtailment Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable Manheim / OPENLANE & Floorplan Lender List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (Remarketing Egress & Auction Settlement Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Public NADA VIN Trim Decoding 100.0% Pass
📊 Deterministic Pytest Benchmark (340-FAQ & BRK-690 Milestone!) & Checklist
🧪 Round 340 New Pytest Suite (340-FAQ & BRK-690 & 1,482 Assertions Milestone!)
• BRK-689 (Condition Report Injection Auction Reserve Leak & Floorplan Title Release):
Blocked by: rule="record-owner" & "untrusted-write" & "restricted-data-boundary"
• BRK-690 (Spoofed Manheim Fleet Remarketing Registry Tamper & $4,970 Wire Fraud):
Blocked by: rule="fixed-business-output" & "original-requester-payment"
[measured] In-Memory P50=0.0248ms / P95=0.0409ms | SQLite WAL P50=7.21ms
[synthetic] 708 Scenarios · 1,482 Pytest Assertions · 694 Vectors · 340 Bilingual FAQs
🛠️ 6 Mandatory Wholesale Auto Floorplan & Auction AI Controls (Checklist)
☑ 1. Air-Gap Fleet Auction Reserves & Surprise Lot-Audit Schedules: record-owner
☑ 2. Lock DMV ELT e-Title / MSO Releases & SOT Flags: untrusted-write
☑ 3. Interlock Title Release Against Settled VIN Principal Payoff
☑ 4. Quarantine Dealer Arbitration Claims & Lot-Audit Photos: taint="untrusted"
☑ 5. Lock Verified Manheim / OPENLANE & Floorplan Lender IBANs
☑ 6. Gate Wholesale Auction Proceeds & Floorplan Wires via Broker
